title: 4 Best Multi-Cookers and Slow Cookers for Easy Weeknights
h1: The 4 Best Multi-Cookers and Slow Cookers
metaDescription: The best electric pressure cookers, combo cookers and slow cookers, matched to how you cook, with honest limitations.
lede: A 6-quart electric pressure cooker suits most households. If you also want air frying, a combo saves counter space, and if you only want set-and-forget stews, a simple slow cooker is enough. Based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.

products.name: Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1 6-Qt Electric Pressure Cooker
products.blurb: The classic Instant Pot: pressure cooker, slow cooker, rice cooker, steamer, sauté pan, yogurt maker and warmer in one 6-quart pot.
strengths: Huge library of recipes written for it
limitations: Pressure cooking takes extra time to build and release pressure
Sealing ring can hold food smells

products.name: Instant Pot Duo Plus 9-in-1 6-Qt Electric Pressure Cooker
products.bestFor: people who want more presets and a clearer display
products.blurb: Builds on the Duo with extra functions, including a sterilize setting, and a display that shows cooking progress.
strengths: Easier to see what stage it's in
Same recipes work as for the Duo
limitations: Extra functions go unused by many owners

products.name: Ninja Foodi OL501 6.5-Qt Pressure Cooker and Air Fryer
products.searchQuery: Ninja Foodi OL501 6.5 quart SmartLid pressure cooker air fryer
products.bestFor: people who want a pressure cooker and air fryer in one
products.blurb: A single SmartLid switches between pressure cooking, air frying and combined modes, so you can pressure cook and then crisp in the same pot.
limitations: Air frying capacity is smaller than a dedicated large air fryer

products.name: Crock-Pot 7-Quart Manual Slow Cooker
products.searchQuery: Crock-Pot 7 quart oval manual slow cooker SCV700SS
products.blurb: A large oval slow cooker with a simple low, high and warm dial. No programs to learn.
strengths: Big enough for a whole chicken or large roast
limitations: No timer, so it won't switch to warm on its own

howWeChose: We chose picks for different cooking styles: all-in-one, upgrade, combo and simple slow cooking.
Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.

faqs.q: What size multi-cooker should I get?
faqs.a: 6 quarts suits most households of two to four. Choose 8 quarts for larger families or batch cooking, and 3 quarts for one or two people.

faqs.q: Can a pressure cooker replace a slow cooker?
faqs.a: Most electric pressure cookers have a slow cook mode, but owner reports suggest it often runs differently from a traditional slow cooker. If slow cooking is your main use, a dedicated slow cooker is simpler.
